description: Otaq agent signals: each hook passes its JSON to `otaq hook --tool claude <event>`, which does nothing unless OTAQ_TICKET is set (and nothing at all when otaq isn't installed).

hooks.command: command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool claude Notification
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool claude Stop
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool claude StopFailure
command -v otaq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; otaq hook --tool claude UserPromptSubmit
